requests.prompt: Finish this existing 128x256 pixel-art surface texture for a clean standardized cryosleep pod. This is an unfolded opaque canopy color map, NOT a picture of an object. Keep the exact canvas and existing layout: the light central long access skin, cool-gray bevel bands on each side, the existing crosswise end joints and the small printed label near the bottom. Develop it into polished game pixel art: clear stepped edge highlights and contact-dark lines, ivory coated shell contrasted against slate structural edges, restrained small fastener marks at the existing panel corners, subtle material differences, finely placed 1-2 pixel wear nicks only along exposed edges and joints. Give the large central panel controlled broad two-tone shading with clean pixel clusters. Preserve quiet areas between detailed regions. All visible surface details are hand-painted albedo, crisply clustered at native pixel size. Keep the color family ivory, desaturated teal-gray, charcoal and restrained cool slate. Rich purposeful surface information, not random spots or texture noise. Do not add more panel subdivisions, hardware silhouettes, windows, perspective, cast shadows, photoreal gradients, glow, neon, dirty patches or rust. No text generation needed. Keep all pixels opaque and preserve the image aspect ratio.

Refine the existing surfaces with rich deliberate pixel-art detail: clear light pixels on upper edges, darker pixels in seams and the lower lip, subtle warm-ivory versus cool slate material contrast, painted corner fasteners, edge-localized fine wear, orderly compact print-like marks in the existing label areas. Coated surface is mostly clean and calm; small controlled two-tone pixel clusters convey the finish, no scattered stain blobs. Readable architecture-level texture craftsmanship, all details painted onto the existing flat surface. Use a cohesive limited palette of ivory, slate-blue-gray, desaturated teal and charcoal. No extra horizontal bands, no repeated rectangular panel grid, no new vents or machinery, no physical protrusions, no perspective, no surrounding object, no neon, rust, dirt clouds, realistic gradients or cast shadows. Keep the source geometry interpretation and 256x80 aspect ratio unchanged and all pixels opaque.
